prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Account safety and persistence hints on sign-in, along with path duration and persistence hints, consistently proved helpful, though several hints showed no clear effect.
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection was helpful, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Personality-driven headlines and live generation countdown timers were helpful, but general copy overhauls, story copy, and time headlines either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens had early wins but later hurt or showed no clear effect; sub-flows, trait selectors, and major redesigns consistently hurt or had no clear effect.
Notifications, chimes, layout modifications, badges/incentives, and wait-screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy changes, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains from targeted hints, headlines, and live timers.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom companion photo upload split layout redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen using a split view layout to present upload options side-by-side with clear photo recommendations. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (69.3%) and users report custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop tray pet quick toggle guide screen: Add a new screen after home intro guiding users on how to control and show or hide their pet using the system tray. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 71.6% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to hide or control their pet.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion trait personality matching quiz flow: Insert a short personality quiz sub-flow screen prior to picking a companion to help guide character selection. (why: Adoption takes a median of 89s with high mean time (1017s) and 69.3% drop-off, indicating users struggle to pick the right pet.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story screen spotlight layout redesign: Redesign the onboarding story screen using a focused spotlight layout to highlight companion benefits immediately. (why: Choose path step has a high mean duration (514s), showing users spend significant time reading initial story content.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing pet restoration account sign-in note: Add a prominent sign-in hint explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account data reset. (why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Live background companion rendering tip ticker: Display a dynamic tip delay sequence on the waiting screen while background companion rendering completes. (why: The waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off before reaching the home screen.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Companion journey path selection headline refresh: Refresh the main headline on the path selection screen to emphasize instant companion setup. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s; concise messaging accelerates initial decision making.)
7: [finish, incentive] Home intro desktop pet launch checklist component: Add an interactive checklist component on the home intro screen detailing final desktop activation steps. (why: Finish step drop-off is 71.6% with mean time 5815s, showing friction when completing final onboarding steps.)
8: [home, notification] Background generation completion desktop notification alert: Enable desktop notification alerts on the wait screen so users receive a prompt when pet generation completes. (why: Home wait time has a very high mean of 2336s because users switch applications while waiting for generation.)
9: [choose_path, layout] Compact layout for choose path screen: Update the choose path screen to a compact layout to reduce visual clutter and display path options clearly. (why: High mean time (514s) on path selection suggests users experience decision fatigue from cluttered path options.)
